note: Queries that do not resolve against the real schema TODAY, each with the reason and the register item that closes it. See query_contract.mjs. Entries may only be REMOVED — never edited to hide a regression, and never added without a reason. A baselined query that starts passing fails the build, so this list can only shrink.

entries.why: The real schema files this under obs.response_audit; the stub keeps it unqualified in public. The query is correct apart from the prefix, and cannot simply be qualified today: the stub has no obs.response_audit at all — db/000 forward-declares one for FK purposes and DROPs it at line 187 — so qualifying for production breaks the stub, which is what CI currently runs.
